## Why Ping Matters in Gaming

### How Latency Affects Gameplay
Ping measures the round‑trip time it takes for data to travel from your device to the game server and back. Low ping (under 30 ms) feels instantaneous, while anything above 100 ms introduces noticeable lag. In fast‑paced shooters, fighting games, or real‑time strategy titles, that delay can mean the difference between landing a skill shot and watching your opponent dodge it.
